## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `127866082dfd0c5bdc682565d1b750e0509e8920`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/queue.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + none

Read at 2026-11-16T01:32Z. First review of this head; claim: comment 6904798098; lane request 6904789342 on mailbox #33873 (the lane's at-tier reviewer was unavailable). Independence: implemented in an os-steve project thread, dispatched by domain:skills#2 (os-steve); reviewed by os-tesla, who neither dispatched nor implemented it.

No prior record on this PR; findings are numbered fresh and continue no earlier id.

### ① Derived judgments

- One commit on main `dfb8ed35`, +7/−7 across the three `hits` files; each file keeps its line count (104 / 32 / 59). Read: the diff, card #34152 with addendum 6903390117, the claim and os-dev-report, and at head `landing-operations.md` 28-38 and 102, `state-machine.md` 25-28, `platform-readings.md` 246, `security-findings.md` 14 and 56, `SKILL.md` 110/119/145, `execution-duties.md` 92, `label-write.mjs --release`.
- Card change 1 (grading rule): implemented as asked. One signature, two or more independent heads, 2 h, p0 the round it is seen, drops when the fix lands; the addendum's precondition is carried (failing case already on `main`; groups stacked behind one queued pull are one head; that pull's own new red test is a dequeue, not a p0). `SKILL.md` 119 gives p0 its dispatch meaning; no second p0 definition is written.
- Card change 2 (jump): implemented, with one overlap — S1. The audit comment, one-jumper and 3,000-line rules are now cited from `landing-operations.md` 33-38 instead of restated; all three are present there verbatim, and the pointer 「该文」 still resolves through the bullet above it. Nothing lets triage bypass ACCEPT, a governed surface, a release PR or another lane's card: the relay's refusals in `landing-operations.md` 37 are untouched and reason (a) is the only letter named.
- Card change 3 (knock): implemented with the existing `Notify: main-green` key and template; the receiver's step at `landing-operations.md` 102 fits a flake-ejected PR.
- Line-budget deletions, each checked for a surviving home:
  - `triage-duties.md` `Blocked-by:` line — whole: `state-machine.md` 25-26 (line-leading form, prose refused), `platform-readings.md` 246 (the full-run card writes a comment — the clause the seat could not place is there word for word), `SKILL.md` 110 and 272.
  - `triage-duties.md` `Release:` contents line — whole: the retained line above it names `label-write.mjs --release`, which writes the comment, the `Resume-from:` line, the label move and the assignee clear in one stroke and refuses without the provenance text; 「下三行」 to 「下两行」 is the correct consequence.
  - `lanes/queue.md` two lines — whole, as above.
  - `project-forms.md` security line — NOT whole: M1.

### ② Semver level

None: rules text under `.claude/**`, no package, no changeset (`skip-changeset` is right). CI on this head when read: 47 check-runs, 19 success, 25 skipped, 3 still in progress (`Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`), none failed. The verdict below does not wait on them. The PR is still a draft.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface: `.claude/**`, Tier S per the seat's `check-governed-merges` reading; no AGENTS.md span, no ADR anchor, no skill index row and no mailbox key is added or moved. Main's record template prints no `Security-touching:` line for these paths, so this record carries none.
- M1 is a boundary flag as well as a design finding: a security-discipline line is removed from a governed rules file by a card that did not ask for it.
- `landing-operations.md` is not edited, as the claim promised.

### ④ Design judgment

M1 (must-fix) — `project-forms.md` pays its line by deleting 「安全发现只敲上一键,⛔ 不带机制、路径或对象名;余照 `security-findings.md`」. That line is not a second copy that §8 forbids; it is the mailbox's pointer that §8 requires (「信箱…只指向本文」). After this head `project-forms.md` names `security-findings.md` nowhere, so §8's roster is false for the mailbox, and the prohibition on a path or object name in a knock has no general home left (§2 line 14 names mechanism only; 「只带编号」 on the `Notify: security` row covers that one key). Card #34152 asks for nothing on security text, and wording on the security boundary is on the human floor (`triage-duties.md`, 「安全/权限边界」), not a line-budget payer a seat picks. Restore the line and pay with another, or get the maintainer's word on this deletion on the card. The report's open question ② is answered B.

S1 (should-fix) — `lanes/queue.md` line 9 already reads 「本席未开时,分诊在每小时巡查里临时兼本章程」, so the claim's premise that no fallback was named does not hold, and the new 「本席空缺时分诊兼插队:p0 队列 flake 之修复 PR…」 states the deputy rule a second time under a second word for the same condition (未开 / 空缺). It also reads as a narrowing: a seat can take it to mean that a deputising triage may jump only a p0 queue-flake fix, while line 9 hands it the whole charter, reasons (b) and (c) included. What the card adds is an obligation, not a power: same round, report after the fact, never ask the maintainer for what the relay can do. Say that, attached to line 9's condition, in one place.

S2 (should-fix) — end condition. 「修复落地即降」 names no grade to drop to and no reader of 「落地」 (the fix PR merged; the anchor closed by it or not). It also leaves no lapse when no fix lands: a signature that stops ejecting keeps its p0, and `SKILL.md` 119 lets a p0 pause lower-grade work indefinitely. The card's own words are as loose, so this is the text to tighten rather than a departure: name the state after the fix merges (anchor closed, or regraded by the ordinary line above) and what triage does when the 2 h window passes with no further ejection.

N1 (nit) — `triage-duties.md` line 30 still ends 「flake 锚卡判确定性才升」 and the next line grades a flake p0 without determinism; a 「例外」 marker would make the order of the two lines explicit. Line 33's 「不定 p0(归 main-red)」 now names one of two p0 sources.

N2 (nit) — 「一 PR 一敲」 is written on the new `project-forms.md` continuation line and already at `triage-duties.md` 29, which covers every anchor close.

N3 (nit) — neither new rule names where the head count and the list of ejected PRs are read. `lanes/queue.md` line 12 names the merge-queue triage comments and the signature ledger; a three-word pointer would make the count and the knock list reproducible by a second seat.

N4 (nit) — the `notify:main-green` row printed by `record-recognisers.mjs --mailbox-keys` on main still describes only the `Waits-on: main-red` case. The key reads the new knock unchanged, and `scripts/pm/**` is outside this card; the report's open question ① is answered A, a small follow-up card.

Prose: the three additions match each file's register (terse imperative Chinese, ⛔ for prohibitions, half-width backticked identifiers); 「三因至逾 3,000 行」 reads as a range once `landing-operations.md` is open.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9779c869429738b398ff016d3407ccab0d748fb5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/queue.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + none

Delta review of this head against FAIL 6904856669 at 12786608; claim: comment 6905034333; lane request 6905027668 on mailbox #33873 (the lane's at-tier reviewer was unavailable). Independence: implemented in an os-steve project thread, dispatched by domain:skills#2 (os-steve); reviewed by os-tesla, who neither dispatched nor implemented it.

Prior record: FAIL 6904856669 (M1, S1, S2, N1-N4). Each id is judged below against the one fix commit `9779c869` (parent `12786608`, no merge of main, 3 files +7/−8); findings of this round are numbered fresh.

### ① Derived judgments

- Read: `git show 9779c869`, the whole PR diff against merge-base `dfb8ed35`, and at head `lanes/queue.md` 1-26, `landing-operations.md` 26-40, `security-findings.md` §8, `project-forms.md` 53 and 57-59, the header of `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`, the handoff 6905021638. Line counts at head: 31 / 59 / 104.
- Prior M1 — closed. 「安全发现只敲上一键,⛔ 不带机制、路径或对象名;余照 `security-findings.md`」 is back at `project-forms.md` 53, character for character and in its old place, so the whole PR diff no longer touches it: the three prohibitions and the pointer §8 requires of the mailbox are whole.
- The line that pays for it this round: the fleet-table column list 「行 = 仓 · 车道 · 席 · …」, folded into 「列照 `fleet-roster.mjs`」. Judged acceptable. The table body is generated and 「⛔ 不手改」 (`lanes/director.md` 82), so the deleted line was a description, not a rule a seat acts on; its home is the generator, whose header documents every column and what each reads (in flight, awaiting ruling, awaiting landing, wall note, last activity, mailbox). `git grep` at head finds no other Chinese copy of the list, and none is owed. 「一席一行」 and the three regeneration moments are kept.
- Prior S1 — closed. The second deputy rule 「本席空缺时分诊兼插队…」 is gone; the obligation now continues line 9's own condition 「本席未开时」 and its sentence 「临时兼本章程」 survives verbatim, so the whole charter, reasons (b) and (c) included, still passes to triage. One word for the condition. Residue: N1.
- Prior S2 — closed. 「修复合入关卡」 names the reader of the end (the fix PR merged) and the state after it (the anchor closed); 「2h 无新踢按上行定」 gives the lapse: the grade returns to the ordinary line above, where a flake anchor rises only when judged deterministic. A p0 can no longer outlive both its fix and its ejections.
- Prior N1 — closed in the part that mattered (the line now opens 「例外:」 directly under the determinism rule). Line 33's 「不定 p0(归 main-red)」 is unchanged; it binds lane seats, who still set no p0, so it stays a nit and is not renumbered.
- Prior N2 — closed: 「一 PR 一敲」 stands once, at `triage-duties.md` 29.
- Prior N3 — closed: 「名单照 `lanes/queue.md`」 and 「计数插队见 `lanes/queue.md`」 point at the file whose line 12 names the merge-queue triage comments and the signature ledger.
- Prior N4 — open, unchanged and correctly so: the row lives in `scripts/pm/**`, outside the card. The PR body records it as noted and, under the 2026-11-15 p3 standard, files no card; it does not hold this PR.
- The card's precondition survives the compression: failing case already on `main`, groups stacked behind one pull count as one head, that pull's own new red test is a dequeue. The explicit 「非 p0」 is dropped, and follows from the first clause.

### ② Semver level

None: rules text under `.claude/**`, no package, no changeset (`skip-changeset` is right). CI on this head when read: 47 check-runs, all completed — 23 success, 24 skipped, none failed, none running; mergeable state clean. The PR is still a draft.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface: `.claude/**`, Tier S. No AGENTS.md span, ADR anchor, skill index row or mailbox key is added or moved. Main's record template prints no `Security-touching:` line for these paths, so this record carries none; with M1 closed the PR changes no security text at all.
- The handoff's question (is the roster column list an acceptable payer) is answered yes, with the reasons in ①.
- The handoff notes `queue.md` at 31 lines under a ceiling of 32 whose row is in `scripts/pm/**`; left as is, correctly.
- No SQL, no code path: the push-down check does not apply.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- `lanes/queue.md`: holds against `landing-operations.md` 33-38. 「照 (a) 插队」 is the first of the three jump reasons there (the fix for a signature ejecting other people's PRs), which is exactly the card's case; ACCEPT stays the precondition, and the relay's refusals (draft, moved head, governed surface, release PR, one jumper per repo) are untouched. The obligation is the card's: same round, report after the fact, no asking the maintainer for what the relay does.
- `triage-duties.md`: the exception is now ordered under the rule it departs from, bounded at both ends, and `SKILL.md` 119 still gives p0 its only dispatch meaning.
- `project-forms.md`: the knock reuses `Notify: main-green` on the anchor-close line; the receiver's step is unchanged.

N1 (nit) — continues S1's residue. In `lanes/queue.md` 9 a colon joins 「临时兼本章程」 to the new obligation, and a colon can be read as "namely". The preserved sentence makes the whole-charter reading the natural one; 「;另」 or 「,且」 would remove the other. On the same line 「(a)」 appears before the file has introduced the jump, and line 23 uses (a)(b)(c) for the dequeue reasons; 「插队」 beside it disambiguates.

N2 (nit) — new with the rewording. 「中继能插的 ⛔ 不请维护者插」 became 「中继能做的 ⛔ 不请维护者」: the object is gone, so the prohibition now covers every relay action a deputising triage takes, not only the jump. It does not collide with 「报维护者」 on a FAILED relay or the 2-hour push (reporting is not asking), but it is wider than the card's sentence.

N3 (nit) — continues prior N4: the `notify:main-green` row of `record-recognisers.mjs --mailbox-keys` still describes only the `Waits-on: main-red` case. Out of this card's scope; the seat's choice to file no card for it stands.

Prose: register unchanged — terse imperative Chinese, ⛔ for prohibitions, backticked identifiers. 「修复合入关卡」 parses as "the fix merges and closes the card" once read beside 「锚卡关闭」 two lines up.

**Verdict: ACCEPT** · head `9779c869429738b398ff016d3407ccab0d748fb5` · card #34152 (p1) · os-dev-reports 6904760034 → 6905010582 · at-tier contract review 6904856669 (FAIL on `12786608`: M1, S1, S2, N1–N4) → delta 6905064785 (review#2, PASS on this head; prior M1, S1, S2 and N1–N3 closed) · read 2026-11-16T01:48Z.

The grade ends when the fix merges and closes the anchor, or when 2 h pass with no new ejection. While the queue seat is vacant, triage jumps that fix the round it gets ACCEPT, under reason (a), and reports afterwards. Queue-flake anchors reuse `Notify: main-green` for every ejected PR that is still open and out of the queue.

N3: the `--mailbox-keys` row text for `notify:main-green` in `scripts/pm/**`, outside this card. Under the 2026-11-15 p3 standard no card is filed.
- **Seat's own miss, recorded:** the seat's L1 read on the first head passed the deletion of the security-knock line; the L2 review caught it as M1.
